sanskrit: u̱bhaya̍ṁ śṛ̱ṇava̍c ca na̱ indro̍ a̱rvāg i̱daṁ vaca̍ḥ | sa̱trācyā̍ ma̱ghavā̱ soma̍pītaye dhi̱yā śavi̍ṣṭha̱ ā ga̍mat ||
english: May Indra hear this our twofold speech, turning hither; may the bountiful one, most mighty, come with intent toward soma-drinking, united in purpose.

sanskrit: taṁ hi sva̱rāja̍ṁ vṛṣa̱bhaṁ tam oja̍se dhi̱ṣaṇe̍ niṣṭata̱kṣatu̍ḥ | u̱topa̱mānā̍m pratha̱mo ni ṣī̍dasi̱ soma̍kāma̱ṁ hi te̱ mana̍ḥ ||
english: Him, the self-resplendent, the bull, the two divine Wisdom-goddesses have fashioned for strength. Thou sittest foremost in the place of laudation; for thy mind is eager for soma.

sanskrit: ā vṛ̍ṣasva purūvaso su̱tasye̱ndrāndha̍saḥ | vi̱dmā hi tvā̍ harivaḥ pṛ̱tsu sā̍sa̱him adhṛ̍ṣṭaṁ cid dadhṛ̱ṣvaṇi̍m ||
english: Drink deep, O Indra of many gifts, of the pressed soma juice. For we know thee, O lord of bay steeds, as the ever-conquering in battles, the unassailable one who yet dares boldly.

sanskrit: aprā̍misatya maghava̱n tathed a̍sa̱d indra̱ kratvā̱ yathā̱ vaśa̍ḥ | sa̱nema̱ vāja̱ṁ tava̍ śipri̱nn ava̍sā ma̱kṣū ci̱d yanto̍ adrivaḥ ||
english: Do not disappoint us, O bountiful one; so let it be, O Indra, according to thy will and wisdom. May we, hastening, win the prize through thy help, O thou of the full cheeks, O wielder of the bolt.

sanskrit: śa̱gdhy ū̱3̱̍ ṣu śa̍cīpata̱ indra̱ viśvā̍bhir ū̱tibhi̍ḥ | bhaga̱ṁ na hi tvā̍ ya̱śasa̍ṁ vasu̱vida̱m anu̍ śūra̱ carā̍masi ||
english: Be able, O lord of power, O Indra, with all thy aids. For like Bhaga we follow after thee, the glorious, the finder of wealth, O hero.

sanskrit: pau̱ro aśva̍sya puru̱kṛd gavā̍m a̱sy utso̍ deva hira̱ṇyaya̍ḥ | naki̱r hi dāna̍m pari̱mardhi̍ṣa̱t tve yad-ya̱d yāmi̱ tad ā bha̍ra ||
english: Thou art the abundant source of horses, the great maker of cattle, a golden fountain, O god. None can diminish the gift that is in thee; whatever I ask for, bring that to me.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hy ehi̱ cera̍ve vi̱dā bhaga̱ṁ vasu̍ttaye | ud vā̍vṛṣasva maghava̱n gavi̍ṣṭaya̱ ud i̱ndrāśva̍miṣṭaye ||
english: Come thou indeed hither to the swift steed, find the treasure for acquiring wealth. Bestow in abundance, O bountiful one, for the winning of cattle, O Indra, for the winning of horses.

sanskrit: tvam pu̱rū sa̱hasrā̍ṇi śa̱tāni̍ ca yū̱thā dā̱nāya̍ maṁhase | ā pu̍raṁda̱raṁ ca̍kṛma̱ vipra̍vacasa̱ indra̱ṁ gāya̱nto 'va̍se ||
english: Thou dost bestow for gift many thousands and hundreds of herds. We have celebrated the fort-breaker with inspired words, singing to Indra for his help.

sanskrit: a̱vi̱pro vā̱ yad avi̍dha̱d vipro̍ vendra te̱ vaca̍ḥ | sa pra ma̍mandat tvā̱yā śa̍takrato̱ prācā̍manyo̱ aha̍ṁsana ||
english: Whether the unlearned or the learned man, O Indra, has tended thy word — he has rejoiced exceedingly through devotion to thee, O thou of a hundred powers, with the thought turned eastward, without harm.

sanskrit: u̱grabā̍hur mrakṣa̱kṛtvā̍ puraṁda̱ro yadi̍ me śṛ̱ṇava̱d dhava̍m | va̱sū̱yavo̱ vasu̍patiṁ śa̱takra̍tu̱ṁ stomai̱r indra̍ṁ havāmahe ||
english: If the fort-destroyer of mighty arms, the anointer of all, should hear my call — we who desire wealth invoke Indra the lord of wealth, the hundred-powered, with hymns of praise.

sanskrit: na pā̱pāso̍ manāmahe̱ nārā̍yāso̱ na jaḻha̍vaḥ | yad in nv indra̱ṁ vṛṣa̍ṇa̱ṁ sacā̍ su̱te sakhā̍yaṁ kṛ̱ṇavā̍mahai ||
english: We hold no evil thoughts, nor are we niggardly, nor torpid; since we would make Indra the bull our companion at the pressing of the soma.

sanskrit: u̱graṁ yu̍yujma̱ pṛta̍nāsu sāsa̱him ṛ̱ṇakā̍ti̱m adā̍bhyam | vedā̍ bhṛ̱maṁ ci̱t sani̍tā ra̱thīta̍mo vā̱jina̱ṁ yam id ū̱ naśa̍t ||
english: We have yoked the mighty, ever-conquering in battles, the debt-exacting, the indestructible. He knows even a wandering thing; the most skilled charioteer, the vigorous one whom he indeed reaches.

sanskrit: yata̍ indra̱ bhayā̍mahe̱ tato̍ no̱ abha̍yaṁ kṛdhi | magha̍vañ cha̱gdhi tava̱ tan na̍ ū̱tibhi̱r vi dviṣo̱ vi mṛdho̍ jahi ||
english: From that which we fear, O Indra, make us free from fear. Be able, O bountiful one; through thine own aids slay those who hate us, destroy our foes.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hi rā̍dhaspate̱ rādha̍so ma̱haḥ kṣaya̱syāsi̍ vidha̱taḥ | taṁ tvā̍ va̱yam ma̍ghavann indra girvaṇaḥ su̱tāva̍nto havāmahe ||
english: For thou, O lord of bounty, art the lord of mighty bounty for him who worships. We who have pressed soma invoke thee, that Indra the bountiful, beloved of hymns.

sanskrit: indra̱ḥ spaḻ u̱ta vṛ̍tra̱hā pa̍ra̱spā no̱ vare̍ṇyaḥ | sa no̍ rakṣiṣac cara̱maṁ sa ma̍dhya̱maṁ sa pa̱ścāt pā̍tu naḥ pu̱raḥ ||
english: Indra, the spear-thrower, and the slayer of Vṛtra, the guardian from afar, is our most choiceworthy one. May he protect our last, may he protect our middle, may he guard us behind and before.

sanskrit: tvaṁ na̍ḥ pa̱ścād a̍dha̱rād u̍tta̱rāt pu̱ra indra̱ ni pā̍hi vi̱śvata̍ḥ | ā̱re a̱smat kṛ̍ṇuhi̱ daivya̍m bha̱yam ā̱re he̱tīr ade̍vīḥ ||
english: Guard us, O Indra, from behind, from below, from above, and from before, everywhere. Put far from us the divine terror, put far from us the hostile missiles of the ungodly.

sanskrit: a̱dyādyā̱ śvaḥ-śva̱ indra̱ trāsva̍ pa̱re ca̍ naḥ | viśvā̍ ca no jari̱tṝn sa̍tpate̱ ahā̱ divā̱ nakta̍ṁ ca rakṣiṣaḥ ||
english: Today and today, tomorrow and tomorrow, O Indra, save us, and in the time beyond. Thou wilt protect all our singers, O lord of truth, through all the days, by day and by night.

sanskrit: pra̱bha̱ṅgī śūro̍ ma̱ghavā̍ tu̱vīma̍gha̱ḥ sammi̍ślo vi̱ryā̍ya̱ kam | u̱bhā te̍ bā̱hū vṛṣa̍ṇā śatakrato̱ ni yā vajra̍m mimi̱kṣatu̍ḥ ||
english: The heroic breaker-of-foes, the bountiful, the greatly gifted, the battle-joiner for valour — thy two arms, O bull, O thou of a hundred powers, whereon the bolt is fixed, pour down strength.

sanskrit: pro a̍smā̱ upa̍stuti̱m bhara̍tā̱ yaj jujo̍ṣati | u̱kthair indra̍sya̱ māhi̍na̱ṁ vayo̍ vardhanti so̱mino̍ bha̱drā indra̍sya rā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: Offer forward to him the praise-song which he desires. With hymns the soma-pressers increase Indra's mighty strength. Auspicious are the gifts of Indra.

sanskrit: a̱yu̱jo asa̍mo̱ nṛbhi̱r eka̍ḥ kṛ̱ṣṭīr a̱yāsya̍ḥ | pū̱rvīr ati̱ pra vā̍vṛdhe̱ viśvā̍ jā̱tāny oja̍sā bha̱drā indra̍sya rā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: Unmatched and without equal, he alone among men is unwearying. He has grown exceedingly beyond all former things, surpassing all beings with his might. Auspicious are the gifts of Indra.

sanskrit: ahi̍tena ci̱d arva̍tā jī̱radā̍nuḥ siṣāsati | pra̱vācya̍m indra̱ tat tava̍ vī̱ryā̍ṇi kariṣya̱to bha̱drā indra̍sya rā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: Even with a hostile steed the swift-giving one succeeds. That heroic deed of thine, O Indra, is to be proclaimed as thou performest it. Auspicious are the gifts of Indra.

sanskrit: ā yā̍hi kṛ̱ṇavā̍ma ta̱ indra̱ brahmā̍ṇi̱ vardha̍nā | yebhi̍ḥ śaviṣṭha cā̱kano̍ bha̱dram i̱ha śra̍vasya̱te bha̱drā indra̍sya rā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: Come, let us make for thee, O Indra, the prayer-offerings that increase thee, by which, O most mighty, thou art gladdened — here the glorious one wins glory. Auspicious are the gifts of Indra.

sanskrit: dhṛ̱ṣa̱taś ci̍d dhṛ̱ṣan mana̍ḥ kṛ̱ṇoṣī̍ndra̱ yat tvam | tī̱vraiḥ somai̍ḥ saparya̱to namo̍bhiḥ prati̱bhūṣa̍to bha̱drā indra̍sya rā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: Even of the bold thou makest the mind bold, O Indra, when thou art such. When served with the potent soma-juices and honored with reverences by those who adorn themselves with obeisance. Auspicious are the gifts of Indra.

sanskrit: ava̍ caṣṭa̱ ṛcī̍ṣamo 'va̱tām̐ i̍va̱ mānu̍ṣaḥ | ju̱ṣṭvī dakṣa̍sya so̱mina̱ḥ sakhā̍yaṁ kṛṇute̱ yuja̍m bha̱drā indra̍sya rā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: Ṛcīṣama looks down like a man looking on his flock. Pleased with the skill of the soma-presser, he makes a yoke-fellow his companion. Auspicious are the gifts of Indra.

sanskrit: viśve̍ ta indra vī̱rya̍ṁ de̱vā anu̱ kratu̍ṁ daduḥ | bhuvo̱ viśva̍sya̱ gopa̍tiḥ puruṣṭuta bha̱drā indra̍sya rā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: All the gods, O Indra, gave thee heroic strength in accord with thy will. Thou hast become the lord and guardian of all, O thou much-praised. Auspicious are the gifts of Indra.

sanskrit: gṛ̱ṇe tad i̍ndra te̱ śava̍ upa̱maṁ de̱vatā̍taye | yad dhaṁsi̍ vṛ̱tram oja̍sā śacīpate bha̱drā indra̍sya rā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: I laud that supreme power of thine, O Indra, for the obtaining of divine grace — when thou smitest Vṛtra with might, O lord of power. Auspicious are the gifts of Indra.

sanskrit: sama̍neva vapuṣya̱taḥ kṛ̱ṇava̱n mānu̍ṣā yu̱gā | vi̱de tad indra̱ś ceta̍na̱m adha̍ śru̱to bha̱drā indra̍sya rā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: Like one desiring a companion, making the human generations equal — Indra knows that consciousness, and then he is glorified. Auspicious are the gifts of Indra.

sanskrit: uj jā̱tam i̍ndra te̱ śava̱ ut tvām ut tava̱ kratu̍m | bhūri̍go̱ bhūri̍ vāvṛdhu̱r magha̍va̱n tava̱ śarma̍ṇi bha̱drā indra̍sya rā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: Upward has thy power arisen, O Indra; upward thyself, upward thy will. Many praisers have increased greatly in thy protection, O bountiful one. Auspicious are the gifts of Indra.

sanskrit: a̱haṁ ca̱ tvaṁ ca̍ vṛtraha̱n saṁ yu̍jyāva sa̱nibhya̱ ā | a̱rā̱tī̱vā ci̍d adri̱vo 'nu̍ nau śūra maṁsate bha̱drā indra̍sya rā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: Let you and I be yoked together, O Vṛtra-slayer, for the gaining of prizes. Even like an adversary, O wielder of the bolt, he will think of us two, O hero. Auspicious are the gifts of Indra.

sanskrit: sa̱tyam id vā u̱ taṁ va̱yam indra̍ṁ stavāma̱ nānṛ̍tam | ma̱hām̐ asu̍nvato va̱dho bhūri̱ jyotī̍ṁṣi sunva̱to bha̱drā indra̍sya rā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: Truly and not falsely do we praise that Indra. Great is his slaying-power against one who presses not soma; abundant are the lights for him who presses soma. Auspicious are the gifts of Indra.

sanskrit: sa pū̱rvyo ma̱hānā̍ṁ ve̱naḥ kratu̍bhir ānaje | yasya̱ dvārā̱ manu̍ṣ pi̱tā de̱veṣu̱ dhiya̍ āna̱je ||
english: He, the foremost of great ones, the shining one, has shone forth with his acts of will, through whose doors Manu the father has shone among the gods with wisdom.

sanskrit: di̱vo māna̱ṁ not sa̍da̱n soma̍pṛṣṭhāso̱ adra̍yaḥ | u̱kthā brahma̍ ca̱ śaṁsyā̍ ||
english: The stones, whose backs are soma, have not sat upon the measure of heaven; the recitations and the prayers are to be proclaimed.

sanskrit: sa vi̱dvām̐ aṅgi̍robhya̱ indro̱ gā a̍vṛṇo̱d apa̍ | stu̱ṣe tad a̍sya̱ pauṁsya̍m ||
english: He, knowing, Indra drove away the cows for the Aṅgirases. I praise that heroic deed of his.

sanskrit: sa pra̱tnathā̍ kavivṛ̱dha indro̍ vā̱kasya̍ va̱kṣaṇi̍ḥ | śi̱vo a̱rkasya̱ homa̍ny asma̱trā ga̱ntv ava̍se ||
english: He, Indra, who in the ancient manner increases the seers, is the sustainer of speech. May he come favorably to our laud at the oblation here to help us.

sanskrit: ād ū̱ nu te̱ anu̱ kratu̱ṁ svāhā̱ vara̍sya̱ yajya̍vaḥ | śvā̱tram a̱rkā a̍nūṣa̱tendra̍ go̱trasya̍ dā̱vane̍ ||
english: And then, according to thy will, svāhā! — the worshippers of the chosen one, the chanters have sung the dog-sacrifice hymn, O Indra, for the giving of the cow-herd.

sanskrit: indre̱ viśvā̍ni vī̱ryā̍ kṛ̱tāni̱ kartvā̍ni ca | yam a̱rkā a̍dhva̱raṁ vi̱duḥ ||
english: In Indra are all heroic deeds, those done and those yet to be done, he whom the singers know as the sacrifice.

sanskrit: yat pāñca̍janyayā vi̱śendre̱ ghoṣā̱ asṛ̍kṣata | astṛ̍ṇād ba̱rhaṇā̍ vi̱po̱3̱̍ 'ryo māna̍sya̱ sa kṣaya̍ḥ ||
english: When the peoples of the five tribes sent out shouts to Indra, he spread out with greatness the inspired utterances of the noble one's thought — that is his dwelling.

sanskrit: i̱yam u̍ te̱ anu̍ṣṭutiś cakṛ̱ṣe tāni̱ pauṁsyā̍ | prāva̍ś ca̱krasya̍ varta̱nim ||
english: And this praise-song of thine has been fashioned for those heroic deeds; thou didst drive forward the turning of the wheel.

sanskrit: a̱sya vṛṣṇo̱ vyoda̍na u̱ru kra̍miṣṭa jī̱vase̍ | yava̱ṁ na pa̱śva ā da̍de ||
english: In the scattering of this bull's generosity, he strode widely for life; like barley for cattle he takes it up.

sanskrit: tad dadhā̍nā ava̱syavo̍ yu̱ṣmābhi̱r dakṣa̍pitaraḥ | syāma̍ ma̱rutva̍to vṛ̱dhe ||
english: Holding that, desiring help, with you as fathers of skill, may we be for the increase of the one accompanied by the Maruts.

sanskrit: baḻ ṛ̱tviyā̍ya̱ dhāmna̱ ṛkva̍bhiḥ śūra nonumaḥ | jeṣā̍mendra̱ tvayā̍ yu̱jā ||
english: Yes! We praise thee, O hero, with hymn-singing for the seasonable abode. May we conquer, O Indra, with thee as ally.

sanskrit: a̱sme ru̱drā me̱hanā̱ parva̍tāso vṛtra̱hatye̱ bhara̍hūtau sa̱joṣā̍ḥ | yaḥ śaṁsa̍te stuva̱te dhāyi̍ pa̱jra indra̍jyeṣṭhā a̱smām̐ a̍vantu de̱vāḥ ||
english: The Rudras, the great ones, the mountain-gods, united in harmony in the slaying of Vṛtra at the invocation of Bhara — upon him who praises and lauds, Pajra has been set; may the gods with Indra as chief protect us.

sanskrit: ut tvā̍ mandantu̱ stomā̍ḥ kṛṇu̱ṣva rādho̍ adrivaḥ | ava̍ brahma̱dviṣo̍ jahi ||
english: May the hymns exhilarate thee; bestow bounty, O wielder of the bolt. Strike down those who hate the sacred word.

sanskrit: pa̱dā pa̱ṇīm̐r a̍rā̱dhaso̱ ni bā̍dhasva ma̱hām̐ a̍si | na̱hi tvā̱ kaś ca̱na prati̍ ||
english: With thy foot press down the Paṇis, the ungenerous ones. Thou art great; none whatsoever can stand against thee.

sanskrit: tvam ī̍śiṣe su̱tānā̱m indra̱ tvam asu̍tānām | tvaṁ rājā̱ janā̍nām ||
english: Thou, O Indra, art lord of those who press soma; thou art lord of those who press not. Thou art king of peoples.

sanskrit: ehi̱ prehi̱ kṣayo̍ di̱vy ā̱3̱̍ghoṣa̍ñ carṣaṇī̱nām | obhe pṛ̍ṇāsi̱ roda̍sī ||
english: Come, advance — thy dwelling is in heaven, resounding gloriously among the peoples. Thou fillest both the worlds.

sanskrit: tyaṁ ci̱t parva̍taṁ gi̱riṁ śa̱tava̍ntaṁ saha̱sriṇa̍m | vi sto̱tṛbhyo̍ rurojitha ||
english: Even that great cloud-mass, the mountain with its hundreds and thousands, thou hast shattered apart for the singers.

sanskrit: va̱yam u̍ tvā̱ divā̍ su̱te va̱yaṁ nakta̍ṁ havāmahe | a̱smāka̱ṁ kāma̱m ā pṛ̍ṇa ||
english: We indeed call upon thee when soma is pressed by day; we call upon thee by night. Fill our desire.

sanskrit: kva1̱̍ sya vṛ̍ṣa̱bho yuvā̍ tuvi̱grīvo̱ anā̍nataḥ | bra̱hmā kas taṁ sa̍paryati ||
english: Where is that young bull with thick neck, unbowed? What priest worships him?

sanskrit: kasya̍ svi̱t sava̍na̱ṁ vṛṣā̍ juju̱ṣvām̐ ava̍ gacchati | indra̱ṁ ka u̍ svi̱d ā ca̍ke ||
english: Whose pressing does the bull descend upon, well pleased? Who then truly approaches Indra?

sanskrit: kaṁ te̍ dā̱nā a̍sakṣata̱ vṛtra̍ha̱n kaṁ su̱vīryā̍ | u̱kthe ka u̍ svi̱d anta̍maḥ ||
english: Whose have thy gifts reached, O Vṛtra-slayer? Whose the heroic deeds? Who is closest in the hymn?

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ te̱ mānu̍ṣe̱ jane̱ soma̍ḥ pū̱ruṣu̍ sūyate | tasyehi̱ pra dra̍vā̱ piba̍ ||
english: This soma of thine is pressed among humankind, among the Pūrus. Come to it, hasten forward, drink.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ te̍ śarya̱ṇāva̍ti su̱ṣomā̍yā̱m adhi̍ pri̱yaḥ | ā̱rjī̱kīye̍ ma̱dinta̍maḥ ||
english: This soma is dear to thee at Śaryaṇāvat, on the banks of Suṣomā; at Ārjīkīyā it is the most intoxicating.

sanskrit: tam a̱dya rādha̍se ma̱he cāru̱m madā̍ya̱ ghṛṣva̍ye | ehī̍m indra̱ dravā̱ piba̍ ||
english: That soma, lovely for great bounty, for intoxication, for exhilaration — come, O Indra, hasten and drink.

sanskrit: yad i̍ndra̱ prāg apā̱g uda̱ṅ nya̍g vā hū̱yase̱ nṛbhi̍ḥ | ā yā̍hi̱ tūya̍m ā̱śubhi̍ḥ ||
english: Whenever thou art called by men, O Indra, eastward, westward, northward, or southward — come quickly with thy swift steeds.

sanskrit: yad vā̍ pra̱srava̍ṇe di̱vo mā̱dayā̍se̱ sva̍rṇare | yad vā̍ samu̱dre andha̍saḥ ||
english: Or if thou art rejoicing at the outpouring of heaven, at the sun's gathering, or in the ocean of the soma-plant —

sanskrit: ā tvā̍ gī̱rbhir ma̱hām u̱ruṁ hu̱ve gām i̍va̱ bhoja̍se | indra̱ soma̍sya pī̱taye̍ ||
english: — thee, the great and wide, I call with hymns, like a cow for enjoying, O Indra, to drink the soma.

sanskrit: ā ta̍ indra mahi̱māna̱ṁ hara̍yo deva te̱ maha̍ḥ | rathe̍ vahantu̱ bibhra̍taḥ ||
english: Let thy bay steeds, O Indra, O god, bearing thy greatness, carry thee in the chariot — they who bear thy might.

sanskrit: indra̍ gṛṇī̱ṣa u̍ stu̱ṣe ma̱hām̐ u̱gra ī̍śāna̱kṛt | ehi̍ naḥ su̱tam piba̍ ||
english: O Indra, I sing thee, I praise thee, the great one, the fierce, the maker of lordship. Come, drink our pressed soma.

sanskrit: su̱tāva̍ntas tvā va̱yam praya̍svanto havāmahe | i̱daṁ no̍ ba̱rhir ā̱sade̍ ||
english: We who have pressed soma, we who are devout, invoke thee. This is our sacred grass for thee to sit upon.

sanskrit: yac ci̱d dhi śaśva̍tā̱m asīndra̱ sādhā̍raṇa̱s tvam | taṁ tvā̍ va̱yaṁ ha̍vāmahe ||
english: For although thou art common to all people forever, O Indra — thee, even thee, we invoke.

sanskrit: i̱daṁ te̍ so̱myam madhv adhu̍kṣa̱nn adri̍bhi̱r nara̍ḥ | ju̱ṣā̱ṇa i̍ndra̱ tat pi̍ba ||
english: The men with the pressing stones have milked this sweet soma for thee. Pleased with it, O Indra, drink it.

sanskrit: viśvā̍m̐ a̱ryo vi̍pa̱ścito 'ti̍ khya̱s tūya̱m ā ga̍hi | a̱sme dhe̍hi̱ śravo̍ bṛ̱hat ||
english: Surveying all the wise nobles, come quickly to us. Bestow upon us great fame.

sanskrit: dā̱tā me̱ pṛṣa̍tīnā̱ṁ rājā̍ hiraṇya̱vīnā̍m | mā de̍vā ma̱ghavā̍ riṣat ||
english: The giver to me of dappled mares, the king of golden women — may the bountiful one not be harmed, O gods.

sanskrit: sa̱hasre̱ pṛṣa̍tīnā̱m adhi̍ śca̱ndram bṛ̱hat pṛ̱thu | śu̱kraṁ hira̍ṇya̱m ā da̍de ||
english: Among the thousand dappled mares, on top — the brilliant, great and broad, pure golden gift, I take it.

sanskrit: napā̍to du̱rgaha̍sya me sa̱hasre̍ṇa su̱rādha̍saḥ | śravo̍ de̱veṣv a̍krata ||
english: The descendants of the hard-to-grasp, of the thousand-fold of good bounty — they made renown among the gods for me.

sanskrit: taro̍bhir vo vi̱dadva̍su̱m indra̍ṁ sa̱bādha̍ ū̱taye̍ | bṛ̱had gāya̍ntaḥ su̱taso̍me adhva̱re hu̱ve bhara̱ṁ na kā̱riṇa̍m ||
english: With songs I invoke for your aid Indra, the finder of wealth, amidst the pressing-stones, singing loudly at the sacrifice where soma has been pressed — I call him like a porter bearing a load.

sanskrit: na yaṁ du̱dhrā vara̍nte̱ na sthi̱rā muro̱ made̍ suśi̱pram andha̍saḥ | ya ā̱dṛtyā̍ śaśamā̱nāya̍ sunva̱te dātā̍ jari̱tra u̱kthya̍m ||
english: Whom the unruly do not hold back, whom the firm-set men do not check in the joy of the well-cheeked one over the soma — who is a giver to the praising presser of the laudable oblation.

sanskrit: yaḥ śa̱kro mṛ̱kṣo aśvyo̱ yo vā̱ kījo̍ hira̱ṇyaya̍ḥ | sa ū̱rvasya̍ rejaya̱ty apā̍vṛti̱m indro̱ gavya̍sya vṛtra̱hā ||
english: Who is capable, the anointer, the horse-like, or the golden young plant — he, Indra the Vṛtra-slayer, makes tremble the releasing of the enclosure of cattle.

sanskrit: nikhā̍taṁ ci̱d yaḥ pu̍rusambhṛ̱taṁ vasūd id vapa̍ti dā̱śuṣe̍ | va̱jrī su̍śi̱pro harya̍śva̱ it ka̍ra̱d indra̱ḥ kratvā̱ yathā̱ vaśa̍t ||
english: Even what is buried, much gathered together, he scatters as wealth for the worshipper. The bolt-wielder of fine cheeks, the bay-horsed — even that Indra does by his will as he wishes.

sanskrit: yad vā̱vantha̍ puruṣṭuta pu̱rā ci̍c chūra nṛ̱ṇām | va̱yaṁ tat ta̍ indra̱ sam bha̍rāmasi ya̱jñam u̱kthaṁ tu̱raṁ vaca̍ḥ ||
english: That which thou hast desired, O much-praised, even of old among men, O hero — that, O Indra, we bring together for thee: sacrifice, hymn, and swift speech.

sanskrit: sacā̱ some̍ṣu puruhūta vajrivo̱ madā̍ya dyukṣa somapāḥ ||
english: Together in the soma-drinkings, O much-invoked, O bolt-wielder, for exhilaration, O heavenly-dwelling soma-drinker.

sanskrit: va̱yam e̍nam i̱dā hyo 'pī̍peme̱ha va̱jriṇa̍m | tasmā̍ u a̱dya sa̍ma̱nā su̱tam bha̱rā nū̱nam bhū̍ṣata śru̱te ||
english: We fattened this bolt-wielder here just yesterday. For him then today bring the soma with equal measure; adorn him now, O glorified one.

sanskrit: vṛka̍ś cid asya vāra̱ṇa u̍rā̱mathi̱r ā va̱yune̍ṣu bhūṣati | semaṁ na̱ḥ stoma̍ṁ jujuṣā̱ṇa ā ga̱hīndra̱ pra ci̱trayā̍ dhi̱yā ||
english: Even a wolf, the ram's wool-puller, adorns himself at the gatherings. Being pleased with this our hymn of praise, come, O Indra, with shining intelligence.

sanskrit: kad ū̱ nv a1̱̍syākṛ̍ta̱m indra̍syāsti̱ pauṁsya̍m | keno̱ nu ka̱ṁ śroma̍tena̱ na śu̍śruve ja̱nuṣa̱ḥ pari̍ vṛtra̱hā ||
english: What unfinished heroic deed of Indra's is there now? By what effort has the Vṛtra-slayer not been heard, from birth?

sanskrit: kad ū̍ ma̱hīr adhṛ̍ṣṭā asya̱ tavi̍ṣī̱ḥ kad u̍ vṛtra̱ghno astṛ̍tam | indro̱ viśvān̍ beka̱nāṭā̍m̐ aha̱rdṛśa̍ u̱ta kratvā̍ pa̱ṇīm̐r a̱bhi ||
english: And what are the great unassailed powers of his? What has the Vṛtra-slayer left unspread? Indra conquers all the beka-nāṭas visible by day, and the Paṇis by wisdom.

sanskrit: va̱yaṁ ghā̍ te̱ apū̱rvyendra̱ brahmā̍ṇi vṛtrahan | pu̱rū̱tamā̍saḥ puruhūta vajrivo bhṛ̱tiṁ na pra bha̍rāmasi ||
english: For thee, O Indra, O Vṛtra-slayer, we most numerous ones bear the prayers, the unprecedented ones, O much-invoked, O bolt-wielder, like wages we bring them forward.

sanskrit: pū̱rvīś ci̱d dhi tve tu̍vikūrminn ā̱śaso̱ hava̍nta indro̱taya̍ḥ | ti̱raś ci̍d a̱ryaḥ sava̱nā va̍so gahi̱ śavi̍ṣṭha śru̱dhi me̱ hava̍m ||
english: Many indeed are the desires of those calling upon thee with Indra's help, O great worker. Even across the pressings of the noble — come, O most wealthy one, O most mighty, hear my call.

sanskrit: va̱yaṁ ghā̍ te̱ tve id v indra̱ viprā̱ api̍ ṣmasi | na̱hi tvad a̱nyaḥ pu̍ruhūta̱ kaś ca̱na magha̍va̱nn asti̍ marḍi̱tā ||
english: We are truly among the inspired ones with thee, O Indra. For there is no other compassionate one than thee, O much-invoked, O bountiful one, none whatsoever.

sanskrit: tvaṁ no̍ a̱syā ama̍ter u̱ta kṣu̱dho̱3̱̍ 'bhiśa̍ste̱r ava̍ spṛdhi | tvaṁ na̍ ū̱tī tava̍ ci̱trayā̍ dhi̱yā śikṣā̍ śaciṣṭha gātu̱vit ||
english: Rescue us from this lack of wisdom, from hunger, from slander. With thine aid, with thy shining wisdom, sustain us, O most able one, knower of the way.

sanskrit: soma̱ id va̍ḥ su̱to a̍stu̱ kala̍yo̱ mā bi̍bhītana | aped e̱ṣa dhva̱smāya̍ti sva̱yaṁ ghai̱ṣo apā̍yati ||
english: Let the soma be pressed for you, O Kalayas — do not fear. This one disperses away of himself; indeed he will go away of himself.

sanskrit: tyān nu kṣa̱triyā̱m̐ ava̍ ādi̱tyān yā̍ciṣāmahe | su̱mṛ̱ḻī̱kām̐ a̱bhiṣṭa̍ye ||
english: Those sovereign Ādityas we shall beseech to come down here, the graciously kind ones, for our succor.

sanskrit: mi̱tro no̱ aty a̍ṁha̱tiṁ varu̍ṇaḥ parṣad arya̱mā | ā̱di̱tyāso̱ yathā̍ vi̱duḥ ||
english: May Mitra bring us across difficulty, may Varuṇa and Aryaman — as the Ādityas know how.

sanskrit: teṣā̱ṁ hi ci̱tram u̱kthya1̱̍ṁ varū̍tha̱m asti̍ dā̱śuṣe̍ | ā̱di̱tyānā̍m ara̱ṁkṛte̍ ||
english: For theirs is the wondrous, hymn-worthy protection for the worshipper, for him who has made himself ready before the Ādityas.

sanskrit: mahi̍ vo maha̱tām avo̱ varu̍ṇa̱ mitrārya̍man | avā̱ṁsy ā vṛ̍ṇīmahe ||
english: Great is your help, O great ones, O Varuṇa, O Mitra, O Aryaman — we choose your aids.

sanskrit: jī̱vān no̍ a̱bhi dhe̍ta̱nādi̍tyāsaḥ pu̱rā hathā̍t | kad dha̍ stha havanaśrutaḥ ||
english: Keep us alive, O Ādityas, before the blow. Why are you named hearers-of-the-call?

sanskrit: yad va̍ḥ śrā̱ntāya̍ sunva̱te varū̍tha̱m asti̱ yac cha̱rdiḥ | tenā̍ no̱ adhi̍ vocata ||
english: Whatever protection is yours for the weary presser of soma, whatever shelter — with that speak over us.

sanskrit: asti̍ devā a̱ṁhor u̱rv asti̱ ratna̱m anā̍gasaḥ | ādi̍tyā̱ adbhu̍tainasaḥ ||
english: There is, O gods, broad escape from distress; there is treasure for the sinless. O Ādityas, there is wonderful freedom from sin.

sanskrit: mā na̱ḥ setu̍ḥ siṣed a̱yam ma̱he vṛ̍ṇaktu na̱s pari̍ | indra̱ id dhi śru̱to va̱śī ||
english: May this snare not fasten on us; may the great one loosen it around us. For Indra is the renowned, the powerful.

sanskrit: mā no̍ mṛ̱cā ri̍pū̱ṇāṁ vṛ̍ji̱nānā̍m aviṣyavaḥ | devā̍ a̱bhi pra mṛ̍kṣata ||
english: May the injury of enemies, of the wicked, not reach us, O you who are not eager for destruction. O gods, wipe us clean.

sanskrit: u̱ta tvām a̍dite mahy a̱haṁ de̱vy upa̍ bruve | su̱mṛ̱ḻī̱kām a̱bhiṣṭa̍ye ||
english: And thee too, O Aditi, I the great one approach calling upon thee, O goddess, for thy gracious mercy, for our succor.

sanskrit: parṣi̍ dī̱ne ga̍bhī̱ra ām̐ ugra̍putre̱ jighā̍ṁsataḥ | māki̍s to̱kasya̍ no riṣat ||
english: Carry us across in poverty, O deep one, O mother of the fierce sons — from the one who would slay us. Let no harm come to our offspring.

sanskrit: a̱ne̱ho na̍ uruvraja̱ urū̍ci̱ vi prasa̍rtave | kṛ̱dhi to̱kāya̍ jī̱vase̍ ||
english: O sinless, wide-ranging, wide-glowing one, for spreading out — make our offspring live.

sanskrit: ye mū̱rdhāna̍ḥ kṣitī̱nām ada̍bdhāsa̱ḥ svaya̍śasaḥ | vra̱tā rakṣa̍nte a̱druha̍ḥ ||
english: They who are the heads of peoples, the undeceivable, self-glorious ones — they guard the sacred ordinances, being without treachery.

sanskrit: te na̍ ā̱sno vṛkā̍ṇā̱m ādi̍tyāso mu̱moca̍ta | ste̱nam ba̱ddham i̍vādite ||
english: O Ādityas, free us from the mouth of wolves, as a bound thief, O Aditi.

sanskrit: apo̱ ṣu ṇa̍ i̱yaṁ śaru̱r ādi̍tyā̱ apa̍ durma̱tiḥ | a̱smad e̱tv aja̍ghnuṣī ||
english: Drive away from us this arrow, O Ādityas, drive away the evil thought. Let it go from us having slain no one.

sanskrit: śaśva̱d dhi va̍ḥ sudānava̱ ādi̍tyā ū̱tibhi̍r va̱yam | pu̱rā nū̱nam bu̍bhu̱jmahe̍ ||
english: For ever through your aids, O Ādityas, good givers, have we indeed enjoyed you before and now.

sanskrit: śaśva̍nta̱ṁ hi pra̍cetasaḥ prati̱yanta̍ṁ ci̱d ena̍saḥ | devā̍ḥ kṛṇu̱tha jī̱vase̍ ||
english: For the wise gods, even him who turns back in sin — the perpetual one — ye make to live.

sanskrit: tat su no̱ navya̱ṁ sanya̍sa̱ ādi̍tyā̱ yan mumo̍cati | ba̱ndhād ba̱ddham i̍vādite ||
english: This good fresh releasing, O Ādityas, which frees — O Aditi, as one bound from bondage.

sanskrit: nāsmāka̍m asti̱ tat tara̱ ādi̍tyāso ati̱ṣkade̍ | yū̱yam a̱smabhya̍m mṛḻata ||
english: There is no crossing beyond that, O Ādityas, to leap across. Be gracious to us.

sanskrit: mā no̍ he̱tir vi̱vasva̍ta̱ ādi̍tyāḥ kṛ̱trimā̱ śaru̍ḥ | pu̱rā nu ja̱raso̍ vadhīt ||
english: May the artificial dart of Vivasvat not strike us, O Ādityas, before old age.

sanskrit: vi ṣu dveṣo̱ vy a̍ṁha̱tim ādi̍tyāso̱ vi saṁhi̍tam | viṣva̱g vi vṛ̍hatā̱ rapa̍ḥ ||
english: Drive away hatred, drive away difficulty, O Ādityas, drive away what is tightly bound. Drive away in all directions the injury.

sanskrit: ā tvā̱ ratha̱ṁ yatho̱taye̍ su̱mnāya̍ vartayāmasi | tu̱vi̱kū̱rmim ṛ̍tī̱ṣaha̱m indra̱ śavi̍ṣṭha̱ satpa̍te ||
english: We turn thy chariot for thy aid, for favor; O greatly-active, O crusher of enemies, O Indra most mighty, O lord of the good.

sanskrit: tuvi̍śuṣma̱ tuvi̍krato̱ śacī̍vo̱ viśva̍yā mate | ā pa̍prātha mahitva̱nā ||
english: O greatly vigorous, O greatly willing, O powerful one, in all thoughts thou hast spread wide with thy greatness.

sanskrit: yasya̍ te mahi̱nā ma̱haḥ pari̍ jmā̱yanta̍m ī̱yatu̍ḥ | hastā̱ vajra̍ṁ hira̱ṇyaya̍m ||
english: By whose greatness the two great ones travel around the earth; whose hands bear the golden bolt.

sanskrit: vi̱śvāna̍rasya va̱s pati̱m anā̍natasya̱ śava̍saḥ | evai̍ś ca carṣaṇī̱nām ū̱tī hu̍ve̱ rathā̍nām ||
english: The lord of all men, the lord of unbowed power, with these — I invoke with the aid of chariots, for the peoples.

sanskrit: a̱bhiṣṭa̍ye sa̱dāvṛ̍dha̱ṁ sva̍rmīḻheṣu̱ yaṁ nara̍ḥ | nānā̱ hava̍nta ū̱taye̍ ||
english: For succor, the ever-growing one, him who rains heaven — men call upon him in many ways for his aid.

sanskrit: pa̱romā̱tra̱m ṛcī̍ṣama̱m indra̱m u̱graṁ su̱rādha̍sam | īśā̍naṁ ci̱d vasū̍nām ||
english: Ṛcīṣama is beyond measure — Indra the fierce, the greatly bountiful, the ruling one even of wealth.

sanskrit: taṁ-ta̱m id rādha̍se ma̱ha indra̍ṁ codāmi pī̱taye̍ | yaḥ pū̱rvyām anu̍ṣṭuti̱m īśe̍ kṛṣṭī̱nāṁ nṛ̱tuḥ ||
english: Him, even him, I urge Indra for great bounty, for drinking — he who rules over the ancient praise-song, the dancer of peoples.

sanskrit: na yasya̍ te śavasāna sa̱khyam ā̱naṁśa̱ martya̍ḥ | naki̱ḥ śavā̍ṁsi te naśat ||
english: No mortal has obtained thy friendship, O most mighty. None has attained thy powers.

sanskrit: tvotā̍sa̱s tvā yu̱jāpsu sūrye̍ ma̱had dhana̍m | jaye̍ma pṛ̱tsu va̍jrivaḥ ||
english: Aided by thee, with thee as ally, may we win great wealth in the waters, in the sun. May we conquer in battles, O wielder of the bolt.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā̍ ya̱jñebhi̍r īmahe̱ taṁ gī̱rbhir gi̍rvaṇastama | indra̱ yathā̍ ci̱d āvi̍tha̱ vāje̍ṣu puru̱māyya̍m ||
english: That thee we approach with sacrifices; that thee with hymns, O most beloved of praises, O Indra — even as thou didst protect the man of many wiles in the contests.

sanskrit: yasya̍ te svā̱du sa̱khyaṁ svā̱dvī praṇī̍tir adrivaḥ | ya̱jño vi̍tanta̱sāyya̍ḥ ||
english: Whose friendship is sweet, whose leading is sweet, O wielder of the bolt — whose sacrifice is to be stretched wide.

sanskrit: u̱ru ṇa̍s ta̱nve̱3̱̍ tana̍ u̱ru kṣayā̍ya nas kṛdhi | u̱ru ṇo̍ yandhi jī̱vase̍ ||
english: Make wide room for our body, wide room for our dwelling. Grant us wide room for living.

sanskrit: u̱ruṁ nṛbhya̍ u̱ruṁ gava̍ u̱ruṁ rathā̍ya̱ panthā̍m | de̱vavī̍tim manāmahe ||
english: A wide path for men, wide for cattle, wide for the chariot — we think of the divine journey.

sanskrit: upa̍ mā̱ ṣaḍ dvā-dvā̱ nara̱ḥ soma̍sya̱ harṣyā̍ | tiṣṭha̍nti svādurā̱taya̍ḥ ||
english: Beside me six pairs of men stand in the joy of soma — they are sweet-gifted ones.

sanskrit: ṛ̱jrāv i̍ndro̱ta ā da̍de̱ harī̱ ṛkṣa̍sya sū̱navi̍ | ā̱śva̱me̱dhasya̱ rohi̍tā ||
english: Two bright steeds Indra took and gave to the son of Ṛkṣa: the two bay horses of the horse-sacrifice.

sanskrit: su̱rathā̍m̐ ātithi̱gve sva̍bhī̱śūm̐r ā̱rkṣe | ā̱śva̱me̱dhe su̱peśa̍saḥ ||
english: Of good chariot for Atithigva, of good reins from Ṛkṣa — at the horse-sacrifice, of beautiful ornament.

sanskrit: ṣaḻ aśvā̍m̐ ātithi̱gva i̍ndro̱te va̱dhūma̍taḥ | sacā̍ pū̱takra̍tau sanam ||
english: Six horses for Atithigva, accompanied by Indra, with a bride, together with pure action, as a prize.

sanskrit: aiṣu̍ ceta̱d vṛṣa̍ṇvaty a̱ntar ṛ̱jreṣv aru̍ṣī | sva̱bhī̱śuḥ kaśā̍vatī ||
english: Among those bay horses he discerned the reddish one among the brilliant ones — one with good reins and a whip.

sanskrit: na yu̱ṣme vā̍jabandhavo nini̱tsuś ca̱na martya̍ḥ | a̱va̱dyam adhi̍ dīdharat ||
english: Among you, O prize-companions, no mortal who would seek to reproach can bear reproach.

sanskrit: pra-pra̍ vas tri̱ṣṭubha̱m iṣa̍m ma̱ndadvī̍rā̱yenda̍ve | dhi̱yā vo̍ me̱dhasā̍taye̱ pura̱ṁdhyā vi̍vāsati ||
english: He glorifies you — the refreshment of the triṣṭubh meter, for the soma-drop that gladdens heroes — with wisdom, with clever intelligence, for the winning of sacrificial food.

sanskrit: na̱daṁ va̱ oda̍tīnāṁ na̱daṁ yoyu̍vatīnām | pati̍ṁ vo̱ aghnyā̍nāṁ dhenū̱nām i̍ṣudhyasi ||
english: The bull of the swelling waters, the bull of the ever-moving ones — I aim at the lord of your unslayable cows.

sanskrit: tā a̍sya̱ sūda̍dohasa̱ḥ soma̍ṁ śrīṇanti̱ pṛśna̍yaḥ | janma̍n de̱vānā̱ṁ viśa̍s tri̱ṣv ā ro̍ca̱ne di̱vaḥ ||
english: Those dappled cows that pour out the sweet extract cook the soma for him at the birth of the gods, in the three luminous realms of heaven.

sanskrit: a̱bhi pra gopa̍tiṁ gi̱rendra̍m arca̱ yathā̍ vi̱de | sū̱nuṁ sa̱tyasya̱ satpa̍tim ||
english: Sing forward to the cow-lord of the mountain, to Indra, as he knows it — the son of Truth, the lord of the true.

sanskrit: ā hara̍yaḥ sasṛjri̱re 'ru̍ṣī̱r adhi̍ ba̱rhiṣi̍ | yatrā̱bhi sa̱ṁnavā̍mahe ||
english: The bay steeds have been let loose; the reddish ones are on the sacred grass, where we call out to them together.

sanskrit: indrā̍ya̱ gāva̍ ā̱śira̍ṁ dudu̱hre va̱jriṇe̱ madhu̍ | yat sī̍m upahva̱re vi̱dat ||
english: The cows milked the mixed drink of honey for Indra the bolt-wielder, when he found them in the hidden place.

sanskrit: ud yad bra̱dhnasya̍ vi̱ṣṭapa̍ṁ gṛ̱ham indra̍ś ca̱ ganva̍hi | madhva̍ḥ pī̱tvā sa̍cevahi̱ triḥ sa̱pta sakhyu̍ḥ pa̱de ||
english: When we two go up to the topmost abode of the sun, the house, and Indra — having drunk of the honey, may we two be together in the thrice-seven steps of the friend.

sanskrit: arca̍ta̱ prārca̍ta̱ priya̍medhāso̱ arca̍ta | arca̍ntu putra̱kā u̱ta pura̱ṁ na dhṛ̱ṣṇv a̍rcata ||
english: Sing, sing forward, O Priyamedhas, sing. Let the young sons also sing. Sing boldly as if to a citadel.

sanskrit: ava̍ svarāti̱ garga̍ro go̱dhā pari̍ saniṣvaṇat | piṅgā̱ pari̍ caniṣkada̱d indrā̍ya̱ brahmodya̍tam ||
english: The lute sounds down, the lute of the go-dhā skin resounds all around, the tawny one leaps all around — the sacred word raised up for Indra.

sanskrit: ā yat pata̍nty e̱nya̍ḥ su̱dughā̱ ana̍pasphuraḥ | a̱pa̱sphura̍ṁ gṛbhāyata̱ soma̱m indrā̍ya̱ pāta̍ve ||
english: When the desirable ones, the good milkers, fly hither without a kick — grasp the kicking soma for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: apā̱d indro̱ apā̍d a̱gnir viśve̍ de̱vā a̍matsata | varu̍ṇa̱ id i̱ha kṣa̍ya̱t tam āpo̍ a̱bhy a̍nūṣata va̱tsaṁ sa̱ṁśiśva̍rīr iva ||
english: Indra drank, Agni drank, all the gods rejoiced. Varuṇa alone dwells here; the waters have hymned him as calves around a cow lowing together.

sanskrit: su̱de̱vo a̍si varuṇa̱ yasya̍ te sa̱pta sindha̍vaḥ | a̱nu̱kṣara̍nti kā̱kuda̍ṁ sū̱rmya̍ṁ suṣi̱rām i̍va ||
english: Thou art a good god, O Varuṇa, whose seven rivers flow along thy palate like through a hollow pipe.

sanskrit: yo vyatī̱m̐r aphā̍ṇaya̱t suyu̍ktā̱m̐ upa̍ dā̱śuṣe̍ | ta̱kvo ne̱tā tad id vapu̍r upa̱mā yo amu̍cyata ||
english: He who drove the fleet ones, the well-yoked ones, toward the worshipper — the swift one is the leader; that indeed is the form of the supreme one who was released.

sanskrit: atīd u̍ śa̱kra o̍hata̱ indro̱ viśvā̱ ati̱ dviṣa̍ḥ | bhi̱nat ka̱nīna̍ oda̱nam pa̱cyamā̍nam pa̱ro gi̱rā ||
english: Indeed the mighty Indra has overpowered, has overcome all enemies. He split the young man's gruel as it was cooking, beyond the song.

sanskrit: a̱rbha̱ko na ku̍māra̱ko 'dhi̍ tiṣṭha̱n nava̱ṁ ratha̍m | sa pa̍kṣan mahi̱ṣam mṛ̱gam pi̱tre mā̱tre vi̍bhu̱kratu̍m ||
english: Like a small boy, a young child, mounting a new chariot — he cooked the mighty wild buffalo for his father and mother, the one of wide-reaching power.

sanskrit: ā tū su̍śipra dampate̱ ratha̍ṁ tiṣṭhā hira̱ṇyaya̍m | adha̍ dyu̱kṣaṁ sa̍cevahi sa̱hasra̍pādam aru̱ṣaṁ sva̍sti̱gām a̍ne̱hasa̍m ||
english: Come, O fine-cheeked lord of the household, mount the golden chariot. Then may we two be together with the heavenly, thousand-footed, reddish one that treads well and is without fault.

sanskrit: taṁ ghe̍m i̱tthā na̍ma̱svina̱ upa̍ sva̱rāja̍m āsate | artha̍ṁ cid asya̱ sudhi̍ta̱ṁ yad eta̍va āva̱rtaya̍nti dā̱vane̍ ||
english: The reverential ones sit near him, the self-resplendent one. Even the purpose of his well-placed offering, which the comers turn back for giving.

sanskrit: anu̍ pra̱tnasyauka̍saḥ pri̱yame̍dhāsa eṣām | pūrvā̱m anu̱ praya̍tiṁ vṛ̱ktaba̍rhiṣo hi̱tapra̍yasa āśata ||
english: Following the ancient dwelling of these Priyamedhas, the grass-strew preparers of well-laid offerings have partaken of the earlier guidance.

sanskrit: yo rājā̍ carṣaṇī̱nāṁ yātā̱ rathe̍bhi̱r adhri̍guḥ | viśvā̍sāṁ taru̱tā pṛta̍nānā̱ṁ jyeṣṭho̱ yo vṛ̍tra̱hā gṛ̱ṇe ||
english: Him who is king of peoples, traveler with chariots, unchecked — the conqueror of all battles, the greatest, who is the Vṛtra-slayer — him I praise.

sanskrit: indra̱ṁ taṁ śu̍mbha puruhanma̱nn ava̍se̱ yasya̍ dvi̱tā vi̍dha̱rtari̍ | hastā̍ya̱ vajra̱ḥ prati̍ dhāyi darśa̱to ma̱ho di̱ve na sūrya̍ḥ ||
english: Adorn that Indra for aid, O thou of many slayings — in whose supporting pair of hands the bolt has been placed, the visible one, great as the sun in the sky.

sanskrit: naki̱ṣ ṭaṁ karma̍ṇā naśa̱d yaś ca̱kāra̍ sa̱dāvṛ̍dham | indra̱ṁ na ya̱jñair vi̱śvagū̍rta̱m ṛbhva̍sa̱m adhṛ̍ṣṭaṁ dhṛ̱ṣṇvo̍jasam ||
english: None can reach by action the one who made the ever-growing — Indra, praised everywhere through sacrifices, the skillful, the indomitable, the boldly powerful.

sanskrit: aṣā̍ḻham u̱gram pṛta̍nāsu sāsa̱hiṁ yasmi̍n ma̱hīr u̍ru̱jraya̍ḥ | saṁ dhe̱navo̱ jāya̍māne anonavu̱r dyāva̱ḥ kṣāmo̍ anonavuḥ ||
english: The unconquerable, fierce, ever-conquering in battles — in whose birth the great, wide-coursing ones, the cows bellowed together; heaven and earth bellowed.

sanskrit: yad dyāva̍ indra te śa̱taṁ śa̱tam bhūmī̍r u̱ta syuḥ | na tvā̍ vajrin sa̱hasra̱ṁ sūryā̱ anu̱ na jā̱tam a̍ṣṭa̱ roda̍sī ||
english: If there were a hundred heavens, O Indra, and a hundred earths — a thousand suns would not match thee, O bolt-wielder; the two worlds did not encompass the newborn one.

sanskrit: ā pa̍prātha mahi̱nā vṛṣṇyā̍ vṛṣa̱n viśvā̍ śaviṣṭha̱ śava̍sā | a̱smām̐ a̍va maghava̱n goma̍ti vra̱je vajri̍ñ ci̱trābhi̍r ū̱tibhi̍ḥ ||
english: Thou hast spread wide with the bullish greatness of virility, O bull, O most mighty, with all strength. Protect us, O bountiful one, in the cow-possessing enclosure, O wielder of the bolt, with wonderful aids.

sanskrit: na sī̱m ade̍va āpa̱d iṣa̍ṁ dīrghāyo̱ martya̍ḥ | eta̍gvā ci̱d ya eta̍śā yu̱yoja̍te̱ harī̱ indro̍ yu̱yoja̍te ||
english: No godless mortal of long life has obtained his refreshment. Even the swift one — he who has yoked the swift bay pair, Indra has yoked them.

sanskrit: taṁ vo̍ ma̱ho ma̱hāyya̱m indra̍ṁ dā̱nāya̍ sa̱kṣaṇi̍m | yo gā̱dheṣu̱ ya āra̍ṇeṣu̱ havyo̱ vāje̱ṣv asti̱ havya̍ḥ ||
english: That great, greatly invocable Indra, the ever-present for giving — who is invocable in the shallows, who in the forests, who is invocable in the contests.

sanskrit: ud ū̱ ṣu ṇo̍ vaso ma̱he mṛ̱śasva̍ śūra̱ rādha̍se | ud ū̱ ṣu ma̱hyai ma̍ghavan ma̱ghatta̍ya̱ ud i̍ndra̱ śrave̍ se ma̱he ||
english: Rouse us up indeed, O wealthy one, for the great bounty; touch us, O hero. Rouse us indeed, O bountiful one, for great generosity. Rouse us, O Indra, for great fame.

sanskrit: tvaṁ na̍ indra ṛta̱yus tvā̱nido̱ ni tṛ̍mpasi | madhye̍ vasiṣva tuvinṛmṇo̱rvor ni dā̱saṁ śi̍śnatho̱ hathai̍ḥ ||
english: Thou, O Indra, dost satisfy us who seek truth, who speak thy praise. Dwell in our midst, O greatly heroic one; with thy blows cut down the Dāsa in the wide space.

sanskrit: a̱nyavra̍ta̱m amā̍nuṣa̱m aya̍jvāna̱m ade̍vayum | ava̱ svaḥ sakhā̍ dudhuvīta̱ parva̍taḥ su̱ghnāya̱ dasyu̱m parva̍taḥ ||
english: The one of alien rites, the inhuman, the non-sacrificing, the ungodly — the mountain, the friend of the good, has shaken him down; the mountain has shaken the Dasyu down for easy slaying.

sanskrit: tvaṁ na̍ indrāsā̱ṁ haste̍ śaviṣṭha dā̱vane̍ | dhā̱nānā̱ṁ na saṁ gṛ̍bhāyāsma̱yur dviḥ saṁ gṛ̍bhāyāsma̱yuḥ ||
english: Do thou, O Indra, most mighty, grasp their hand for giving — like grains gathered up, do thou who art eager for us gather them together twice for us.

sanskrit: sakhā̍ya̱ḥ kratu̍m icchata ka̱thā rā̍dhāma śa̱rasya̍ | upa̍stutim bho̱jaḥ sū̱rir yo ahra̍yaḥ ||
english: Friends, seek the wisdom — how shall we attain the purpose of Śara? The praise-song is for Bhoja the patron, the seer who is without shame.

sanskrit: bhūri̍bhiḥ samaha̱ ṛṣi̍bhir ba̱rhiṣma̍dbhiḥ staviṣyase | yad i̱ttham eka̍m-eka̱m ic chara̍ va̱tsān pa̍rā̱dada̍ḥ ||
english: Thou wilt be praised together with many seers spreading the sacred grass, since in this way Śara gave the calves one by one.

sanskrit: ka̱rṇa̱gṛhyā̍ ma̱ghavā̍ śaurade̱vyo va̱tsaṁ na̍s tri̱bhya āna̍yat | a̱jāṁ sū̱rir na dhāta̍ve ||
english: The bountiful Śauradeya, taking by the ear, brought the calf to us from the three — and the she-goat for the seer to sustain.
